info.title: Sales Reports API
info.description: A set of endpoints to manage and retrieve sales dashboard data within the inTandem platform, providing detailed insights on payments and forecasts.

servers.description: Main API Gateway server for accessing sales reports

PaymentsWidget.description: Payments widget data containing total payments, overdue payments summary, and pending estimates. Each section is wrapped in a success/data envelope.

total_payments.description: Total payments section wrapped in success/data envelope.

data.description: Collected payment totals in the business currency. A payment is counted when its status is paid, it is not archived, its currency is the business currency, and its paid date is in the period. Refunded and partially refunded payments are not counted. Without `start_time` and `end_time`, the year-to-date fields are returned. With both, the date range fields are returned.

current_year.description: Year-to-date mode only. Amount collected from January 1 of the current year until today (e.g., 15230.5).

last_year.description: Year-to-date mode only. Amount collected in the same period of the previous year, from January 1 until the same day last year. Null when the business was created during that period (e.g., 12100.0 or null).

current_year_by_payment_method.description: Year-to-date mode only, and only when `group_by=payment_method`. The `current_year` amount split by online/offline and by payment method.

last_year_by_payment_method.description: Year-to-date mode only, and only when `group_by=payment_method`. The `last_year` amount split by online/offline and by payment method. Null when `last_year` is null.

date_range_total.description: Date range mode only. Amount collected between `start_time` and `end_time` (e.g., 8400.0).

date_range_by_payment_method.description: Date range mode only, and only when `group_by=payment_method`. The `date_range_total` amount split by online/offline and by payment method.

date_range.description: Date range mode only. The range that was applied, echoed from the request.

overdue_payments_summary.description: Overdue payments summary section wrapped in success/data envelope.

total_overdue.description: The total overdue amount of payment requests. Null if no overdue payments.

total_overdue_count.description: The total number of overdue payment requests.

last_week.description: Total overdue payment requests amount from the last week.

last_week_count.description: Number of overdue payment requests from the last week.

last_month.description: Total overdue payment requests amount from the last month.

last_month_count.description: Number of overdue payment requests from the last month.

old.description: The total amount for overdue payment requests that are older than 30 days.

old_count.description: Count of older overdue payment request transactions that are older than 30 days.

pending_estimates.description: Pending estimates section wrapped in success/data envelope.

count.description: The total count of pending payment estimates that have not yet been confirmed.

PaymentMethodBreakdown.description: A collected amount split first by collection type (online or offline) and then by payment method. The split uses the same payments as the total it belongs to, so `online.amount + offline.amount` equals that total. The same payment method name (e.g., "Credit Card") can appear under both `online` and `offline`, so the two groups must not be merged when answering a question about a payment method.

online.description: Payments collected through a payment gateway connected to the business (e.g., Stripe, Square, PayPal). This also includes payments recorded with the payment method "Credit Card (Online)", and offline-recorded payments that are linked to a gateway transaction and can be refunded online.

offline.description: Payments that were collected outside the platform and only recorded in it: entered manually by staff, created through the API as offline payments, or imported from an external system. The money did not move through a gateway connected to the business.

PaymentCollectionTypeTotal.description: Totals for one collection type (online or offline).

amount.description: Total amount collected with this collection type (e.g., 6200.0).

count.description: Number of payments collected with this collection type (e.g., 42).

payment_methods.description: The amount split by payment method, sorted by amount, highest first. Empty when no payments match.

PaymentMethodTotal.description: Totals for one payment method within one collection type.

payment_method.description: The payment method as stored on the payment. It is free text, not a fixed list. Common offline values: "Cash", "Cheque" (a check), "Credit Card", "Bank Transfer", "ACH", "PayPal", "Other". Common online values: "Credit Card", "Bank Payment - ACH", "Bank Payment - SEPA", "Google Pay", "Apple Pay", "iDEAL", "Bancontact", "Twint", "Wallet". Payments recorded as "Other" are grouped under "Other" and are not split by their free-text description. Null groups payments that have no payment method recorded (e.g., "Cheque", "Credit Card" or null).

amount.description: Total amount collected with this payment method (e.g., 3150.0).

count.description: Number of payments collected with this payment method (e.g., 12).

PaymentsForecast.description: Forecast payments data. Response is a map where keys are date strings (YYYY-MM-DD format, representing the start of each week) and values are forecast objects for that week.

additionalProperties.description: Forecast data for a specific week.

total_amount.description: The total forecasted payment amount for the given week.

calendar_week.description: The ISO calendar week number (e.g., 5 for the 5th week of the year).

week_end_date.description: The end date of the week in YYYY-MM-DD format.

PaymentPlansSummary.description: Totals of the business's payment plans. Amounts, and the payment and installment counts that go with them, are in the business currency; payments and plans in any other currency are not included in them. The plan counts in `plans` include plans in every currency, the same as the payment plans list. Only the plans the requesting staff member can see in the payment plans list are counted.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 code of the business currency that every amount is in (e.g., "USD")

collected_this_year.description: Payments collected by payment plans since January 1 of the current year, in the business time zone, until now. A partially refunded payment is counted at its amount minus the refunded part, and a fully refunded payment is not counted.

amount.description: The total amount of those payments, net of partial refunds (e.g., 12500.0)

plans.description: Counts of the business's payment plans by status.

active_count.description: The number of plans in `active` status (e.g., 18)

paused_count.description: The number of plans in `paused` status (e.g., 3)

total_count.description: The number of plans in any status (e.g., 27)

active_installments_due_4_weeks.description: Installments that `active` plans will charge in the next 4 weeks. Every installment due in that window is counted, so a weekly plan can add up to 4, but never more than the installments the plan has left. Each installment is counted at the plan's `amount`.

amount.description: The total amount of those installments (e.g., 4200.0)

plans_require_review.description: Plans in `paused` status, whose last scheduled installment failed to charge. Use `plans.paused_count` for the number of these plans.

amount.description: The sum of the failed installments of the paused plans, one per plan, at the amount that failed to charge. For a linked plan that failed on its last installment, this is the remaining balance, which can be lower than the plan's `amount` (e.g., 950.0)

field.description: The name of the field that caused the error (e.g., "currency").

message.description: A human-readable error message describing the issue.

Bearer.description: Provide a valid bearer token in the Authorization header. Example: 'Authorization: Bearer {app_token}'

get.description:
## Overview
Fetch summarized data for the Payments widget: collected payments, overdue payments, and pending estimates.

Collected payments are returned for one of two periods:
- **Year to date** (no `start_time` / `end_time`): the current year until today, and the same period of the previous year.
- **Date range** (both `start_time` and `end_time`): the given range. When only one of them is sent, year-to-date totals are returned. The range must start on or after January 1 of the previous year.

Send `group_by=payment_method` to also get the collected amount split by collection type (online or offline) and by payment method. Without `group_by`, the response is unchanged. Overdue payments and pending estimates are always current and do not depend on the period or on `group_by`.

All amounts are in the business currency. Payments in other currencies are not included.

## Errors
An invalid date range, an invalid `group_by` value, or a staff member who is not allowed to view payments returns HTTP 200 with `success: true` at the top level and `data.success: false` with the error in `data.errors`.

Available for **Staff, Directory, and Client tokens**

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Start of the date range, ISO 8601. Date range mode is used only when both `start_time` and `end_time` are sent. When only one of them is sent, it is ignored and year-to-date totals are returned. Must be on or after January 1 of the previous year (e.g., "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z").

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: End of the date range, ISO 8601. Date range mode is used only when both `start_time` and `end_time` are sent. Must not be before `start_time` (e.g., "2026-06-30T23:59:59Z").

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: Adds a breakdown of the collected amount. `payment_method`: split by collection type (online or offline) and then by payment method; adds `current_year_by_payment_method` and `last_year_by_payment_method` in year-to-date mode, or `date_range_by_payment_method` in date range mode (e.g., "payment_method").

200.description: Successful response containing Payments widget data.

401.description: Missing, expired or invalid bearer token.

get.description:
## Overview
Fetch detailed data for the Payments forecast widget, providing predictions of future payments on a month-by-month basis. This endpoint is accessible with **Staff Tokens** only.

Available for **Staff, Directory, and Client tokens**

200.description: Successful response containing Payments forecast data.

get.description:
## Overview
Fetch the totals shown at the top of the payment plans page: what plans collected this year, how many plans are active, what active plans will charge in the next 4 weeks, and what failed installments of paused plans require review. The totals cover all of the business's plans and do not take any list filters.

Amounts are in the business currency, and payments and plans in any other currency are not included in them. Plan counts include every currency. Only the plans the requesting staff member can see in the payment plans list are counted.

Available for **Staff tokens**.

200.description: Successful response containing the payment plans summary.

401.description: Missing, expired or invalid bearer token.

errors.message: Authentication is required to access this resource

403.description: The token is valid but not permitted to view payments of this business.

errors.message: You are not allowed to perform this action
